elements.definition_text: The identifier for the Calendar. Submit LEAID-SchoolId-Calendartypecodevalue-Sequence. Example: 4242-5111-5DayAllGrades-01
elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 90002] The July 4 holiday must be reported in the school calendar on the specified date.
[Rule 90003] The Veterans' Day holiday must be reported in the school calendar.
[Rule 90004] If school calendar does not include required December 25 holiday on the specified date, then report discrepancy as error
[Rule 90005] The Thanksgiving Day holiday must be reported in the school calendar on the specified date.
[Rule 90009] If calendar dates are not within the track begin and end dates, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 90010] A school calendar track should have the specified minimum required number of instructional days.
[Rule 90023] If a school submits more than three 4-day PS/KG calendars without School Finance's approval, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 90025] If a school submits a 3-day PS/KG calendar before submitting a primary (5-day or 4-day) calendar, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 90026] If a 3-day calendar for grades 9, 10, 11, or 12 is submitted without School Finance's approval, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 90027] If a 2-day calendar for grades 9, 10, 11, or 12 is submitted without School Finance's approval, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 90028] If a 1-day calendar for grades 9, 10, 11, or 12 is submitted without School Finance's approval, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10071] If a student is submitted with attendance minutes and the student does not have a homebound need, does not have a grade of PS, or does not attend an AOI school or a school with an alternative program/calendar designation, then report the discrepancy with a warning.
[Rule 10084] If the First or Last day of enrollment is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10085] If the First or Last day of FTE is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this date, then report the discr epancy as an error.
[Rule 10086] If the First or Last day of Student Tuition Payer Code is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10087] If the First or Last day of Special Enrollment code is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10088] If the First or Last day of DOR Transfer is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10124] Rule checks for flag=true - if Calendar is valid, else it fails and reports an error.
[Rule 10130] If a grade-level or school for a membership does not align with the calendar type, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10139] If a student’s membership begins on the first day of the instructional calendar and the student is not in attendance within the first 10 days, then report the discrepancy as an error. (Excludes Pre-school Tuition Payer Code 2)
[Rule 10140] If a student begins a membership on a day that is not the first instructional day of the calendar, and the student has an absence amount equal to the FTE of the first membership day or no positive attendance, then report the discrepancy as an error. (Excludes Pre-school Tuition Payer Code 2)
[Rule 20038] If membership has a withdrawal code of WK and the student didn't switch calendars, move from UE to KG, or move from KG to UE, then report the discrepancy as an error.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 90000] If the track begin and end dates are not within the fiscal year, report the discrepancy as warning.
[Rule 90002] The July 4 holiday must be reported in the school calendar on the specified date.
[Rule 90004] If school calendar does not include required December 25 holiday on the specified date, then report discrepancy as error
[Rule 90005] The Thanksgiving Day holiday must be reported in the school calendar on the specified date.
[Rule 90009] If calendar dates are not within the track begin and end dates, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 90018] If a track's end date is not greater than its track begin date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 90019] If there is any missing date between track begin date and end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10037] If DOR end date is not <= Membership end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10038] If DOR dates overlap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10039] If DOR dates have a gap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10057] If an enrollment is submitted with overlapping dates, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10058] If an enrollment has an Exit Status and does not have an Exit Date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10059] If an enrollment has an Exit date and does not have an Exit Status, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10068] If Tuition Payer dates overlap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10069] If Tuition Payer dates reported have a gap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10082] If the Absence amount for any Day of Membership or the Withdrawal Date is greater than the FTE value for that day, then report the discrepancy as a Warning.
[Rule 10083] If the submitted start date (old FTE start date, New FTE start date) is < the school membership date OR if the date is > the withdrawal date (if one exists), then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10084] If the First or Last day of enrollment is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10085] If the First or Last day of FTE is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this date, then report the discr epancy as an error.
[Rule 10086] If the First or Last day of Student Tuition Payer Code is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10087] If the First or Last day of Special Enrollment code is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10088] If the First or Last day of DOR Transfer is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10091] The date of absence or attendance must be on a valid in-session day for the fiscal year within the membership start and end date, else report discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10101] If the Special Enrollment dates overlap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10102] If Special Enrollment dates reported are outside of the enrollment dates, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10103] If Membership FTE dates overlap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10104] If Membership FTE dates reported have a gap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10105] If the Membership end date is before the Membership entry date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10106] If the FTE end date is before the FTE entry date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10107] If the Tuition Payer end date is before the Tuition Payer entry date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10108] If the Special Enrollment end date is before the Special Enrollment entry date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10110] If the submitted start date of Tuition Payer Code is < the school membership date OR if the date is > the withdrawal date (if one exists), then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10111] If the submitted start date of Special Enrollment Code is < the school membership date OR if the date is > the withdrawal date (if one exists), then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10115] If an "Ancillary" enrollment is submitted without a "Main" membership for that student, or more than one enrollment is submitted with "Main" membership during the same enrollment date range of the “Ancillary”, then report discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 10119] If the withdrawal code is WP and the subsequent enrollment's RP start date is not the next instructional day of the track of the subsequent enrollment, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10120] If the withdrawal code is WD and the subsequent enrollment's RD start date is not the next instructional day of the track of the subsequent enrollment, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10136] If a school submits more than one student enrollment record within the same start and end dates of an existing enrollment record at the same school, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10203] If attendance minutes are reported for days after the data capture date, then report the discrepancy as error.
[Rule 10204] If attendance events are reported for days after the data capture date, then report the discrepancy as warning.
[Rule 20011] If the readmission entry date is prior to the Membership date, then report the discrepancy as an error
[Rule 20012] If readmission entry date is earlier than the withdrawal date of Membership, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 20020] If the withdrawal code is WK and there is not a subsequent enrollment date and code of EK in the same year, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 20023] If the withdrawal date is not a valid school date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 20031] If an enrollment is submitted with a summer withdrawal code S7 and entry and exit dates are not between July 1st and August 31st of the Fiscal Year then, report discrepancy as an error.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 90002] The July 4 holiday must be reported in the school calendar on the specified date.
[Rule 90003] The Veterans' Day holiday must be reported in the school calendar.
[Rule 90004] If school calendar does not include required December 25 holiday on the specified date, then report discrepancy as error
[Rule 90005] The Thanksgiving Day holiday must be reported in the school calendar on the specified date.
[Rule 90009] If calendar dates are not within the track begin and end dates, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 90010] A school calendar track should have the specified minimum required number of instructional days.
[Rule 90023] If a school submits more than three 4-day PS/KG calendars without School Finance's approval, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 90025] If a school submits a 3-day PS/KG calendar before submitting a primary (5-day or 4-day) calendar, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 90026] If a 3-day calendar for grades 9, 10, 11, or 12 is submitted without School Finance's approval, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 90027] If a 2-day calendar for grades 9, 10, 11, or 12 is submitted without School Finance's approval, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 90028] If a 1-day calendar for grades 9, 10, 11, or 12 is submitted without School Finance's approval, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10071] If a student is submitted with attendance minutes and the student does not have a homebound need, does not have a grade of PS, or does not attend an AOI school or a school with an alternative program/calendar designation, then report the discrepancy with a warning.
[Rule 10084] If the First or Last day of enrollment is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10085] If the First or Last day of FTE is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this date, then report the discr epancy as an error.
[Rule 10086] If the First or Last day of Student Tuition Payer Code is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10087] If the First or Last day of Special Enrollment code is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10088] If the First or Last day of DOR Transfer is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10124] Rule checks for flag=true - if Calendar is valid, else it fails and reports an error.
[Rule 10130] If a grade-level or school for a membership does not align with the calendar type, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10139] If a student’s membership begins on the first day of the instructional calendar and the student is not in attendance within the first 10 days, then report the discrepancy as an error. (Excludes Pre-school Tuition Payer Code 2)
[Rule 10140] If a student begins a membership on a day that is not the first instructional day of the calendar, and the student has an absence amount equal to the FTE of the first membership day or no positive attendance, then report the discrepancy as an error. (Excludes Pre-school Tuition Payer Code 2)
[Rule 20038] If membership has a withdrawal code of WK and the student didn't switch calendars, move from UE to KG, or move from KG to UE, then report the discrepancy as an error.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 60000] If the reported value for School Year is not valid, report the discrepancy as an error. Invalid Value [School Year] (Course Section)
[Rule 60004] If the Course End Date is reported before the Course Begin Date, report the discrepancy as an error. [Course End Date] Before [Course Begin Date]
[Rule 60005] If the Course End Date is not in the current school year, report the discrepancy as an error. [Course Begin Date] not in Reported [School Year]
[Rule 60006] If the Course End Date is not in the current school year, report the discrepancy as an error. [Course End Date] not in [Reported School Year]
[Rule 60007] If the Course Section was reported with no students enrolled, report the discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 60009] If a course is not a high school course with low grade of 9 or above, report the discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 60010] If the value for a high school course is not 'Y' or 'N', report the discrepancy as an error
[Rule 60011] If the section is reported with more than 50 students, report the discrepancy as a warning. This section has more than 50 students enrolled.
[Rule 60012] If the teacher/provider teacher's Begin Date is before the Course Begin Date, report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [Begin Date] is before the course starts
[Rule 60013] If the teacher/provider teacher's Begin Date is after the Course End Date, report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [Begin Date] is after the course has ended
[Rule 60014] If the teacher/provider teachers End Date is before the course start date, report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [End Date] is before the course has started
[Rule 60015] If the teacher end date is after the course end date, then report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [End Date] is after the course has ended
[Rule 60026] If a student is submitted with a Course-Exit-Date and no Exit Type, report the discrepancy as an error. Exit Type is required when Course-Exit-Date is provided.
[Rule 60027] If a student is submitted in a course as Dual Credit and the course is not identified as Dual Credit, report the discrepancy as an error. Student is shown as {1} which does not align with the [Dual Credit] availability
[Rule 60029] If the Student-Course-Entry-Date is before the Course-Begin-Date, report the discrepancy as an error. Student [Course Entry Date] Before [Course Begin Date]
[Rule 60030] If the Student-Course-Exit-Date is after the Course- End-Date, report the discrepancy as an error. Student [Course Exit Date] After [Course End Date]
[Rule 60031] If the student is enrolled simultaneously in two Sections of the same Course, report the discrepancy as a warning. Student is simultaneously enrolled in two sections of the same course.
[Rule 60032] If the Student-Section-Exit-Date is before the Student-Section-Entry-Date, report the discrepancy as an error. [Section Exit Date] Before [Section Entry Date]
[Rule 60033] If a high school student, taking a course with a low grade/high grade between 9-12, is submitted with an Exit Type and Exit Date for courses as Complete Full Credit (CF) or Complete Partial credit (CP) and credits earned is not reported, report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 60038] If the Educator ID is not submitted for the staff, instructing the CTE course section, report the discrepancy as a warning.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 60000] If the reported value for School Year is not valid, report the discrepancy as an error. Invalid Value [School Year] (Course Section)
[Rule 60004] If the Course End Date is reported before the Course Begin Date, report the discrepancy as an error. [Course End Date] Before [Course Begin Date]
[Rule 60005] If the Course End Date is not in the current school year, report the discrepancy as an error. [Course Begin Date] not in Reported [School Year]
[Rule 60006] If the Course End Date is not in the current school year, report the discrepancy as an error. [Course End Date] not in [Reported School Year]
[Rule 60007] If the Course Section was reported with no students enrolled, report the discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 60009] If a course is not a high school course with low grade of 9 or above, report the discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 60010] If the value for a high school course is not 'Y' or 'N', report the discrepancy as an error
[Rule 60012] If the teacher/provider teacher's Begin Date is before the Course Begin Date, report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [Begin Date] is before the course starts
[Rule 60013] If the teacher/provider teacher's Begin Date is after the Course End Date, report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [Begin Date] is after the course has ended
[Rule 60014] If the teacher/provider teachers End Date is before the course start date, report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [End Date] is before the course has started
[Rule 60015] If the teacher end date is after the course end date, then report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [End Date] is after the course has ended
[Rule 60026] If a student is submitted with a Course-Exit-Date and no Exit Type, report the discrepancy as an error. Exit Type is required when Course-Exit-Date is provided.
[Rule 60027] If a student is submitted in a course as Dual Credit and the course is not identified as Dual Credit, report the discrepancy as an error. Student is shown as {1} which does not align with the [Dual Credit] availability
[Rule 60029] If the Student-Course-Entry-Date is before the Course-Begin-Date, report the discrepancy as an error. Student [Course Entry Date] Before [Course Begin Date]
[Rule 60030] If the Student-Course-Exit-Date is after the Course- End-Date, report the discrepancy as an error. Student [Course Exit Date] After [Course End Date]
[Rule 60031] If the student is enrolled simultaneously in two Sections of the same Course, report the discrepancy as a warning. Student is simultaneously enrolled in two sections of the same course.
[Rule 60033] If a high school student, taking a course with a low grade/high grade between 9-12, is submitted with an Exit Type and Exit Date for courses as Complete Full Credit (CF) or Complete Partial credit (CP) and credits earned is not reported, report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 60038] If the Educator ID is not submitted for the staff, instructing the CTE course section, report the discrepancy as a warning.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 40000] The SPED matrix defines the validation rules for concurrent SPED needs. For a student submitted with program participation, if a combination of Need codes submitted which do not comply with the *Concurrent Need Eligibility matrix, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40003] If a student is submitted as attending SPED program participation at the entity level, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40040] If concurrent SPED program participations for a single student are reported with different DORs, fail integrity for all DORS.
[Rule 40066] If the submitted Special Education Setting does not match the program name, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40067] If a SPED program is submitted for a student without Main SPED School indicator, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40069] Student SPED participation must be within a membership at a school. If each day of SPED program participation does not have an enrollment at a given school in a given Fiscal Year, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40086] SPED14 (No longer eligible for preschool special education and not attending any education programs) is exclusively an exit code that pertains to Preschool students only and therefore may only be used when the corresponding enrollment grade is PS, and enrollment ends on the same date.

[Rule 60000] If the reported value for School Year is not valid, report the discrepancy as an error. Invalid Value [School Year] (Course Section)
[Rule 60007] If the Course Section was reported with no students enrolled, report the discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 60011] If the section is reported with more than 50 students, report the discrepancy as a warning. This section has more than 50 students enrolled.
[Rule 60031] If the student is enrolled simultaneously in two Sections of the same Course, report the discrepancy as a warning. Student is simultaneously enrolled in two sections of the same course.
[Rule 60032] If the Student-Section-Exit-Date is before the Student-Section-Entry-Date, report the discrepancy as an error. [Section Exit Date] Before [Section Entry Date]
[Rule 60038] If the Educator ID is not submitted for the staff, instructing the CTE course section, report the discrepancy as a warning.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 60000] If the reported value for School Year is not valid, report the discrepancy as an error. Invalid Value [School Year] (Course Section)
[Rule 60004] If the Course End Date is reported before the Course Begin Date, report the discrepancy as an error. [Course End Date] Before [Course Begin Date]
[Rule 60005] If the Course End Date is not in the current school year, report the discrepancy as an error. [Course Begin Date] not in Reported [School Year]
[Rule 60006] If the Course End Date is not in the current school year, report the discrepancy as an error. [Course End Date] not in [Reported School Year]
[Rule 60007] If the Course Section was reported with no students enrolled, report the discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 60009] If a course is not a high school course with low grade of 9 or above, report the discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 60010] If the value for a high school course is not 'Y' or 'N', report the discrepancy as an error
[Rule 60011] If the section is reported with more than 50 students, report the discrepancy as a warning. This section has more than 50 students enrolled.
[Rule 60012] If the teacher/provider teacher's Begin Date is before the Course Begin Date, report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [Begin Date] is before the course starts
[Rule 60013] If the teacher/provider teacher's Begin Date is after the Course End Date, report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [Begin Date] is after the course has ended
[Rule 60014] If the teacher/provider teachers End Date is before the course start date, report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [End Date] is before the course has started
[Rule 60015] If the teacher end date is after the course end date, then report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [End Date] is after the course has ended
[Rule 60026] If a student is submitted with a Course-Exit-Date and no Exit Type, report the discrepancy as an error. Exit Type is required when Course-Exit-Date is provided.
[Rule 60027] If a student is submitted in a course as Dual Credit and the course is not identified as Dual Credit, report the discrepancy as an error. Student is shown as {1} which does not align with the [Dual Credit] availability
[Rule 60029] If the Student-Course-Entry-Date is before the Course-Begin-Date, report the discrepancy as an error. Student [Course Entry Date] Before [Course Begin Date]
[Rule 60030] If the Student-Course-Exit-Date is after the Course- End-Date, report the discrepancy as an error. Student [Course Exit Date] After [Course End Date]
[Rule 60031] If the student is enrolled simultaneously in two Sections of the same Course, report the discrepancy as a warning. Student is simultaneously enrolled in two sections of the same course.
[Rule 60032] If the Student-Section-Exit-Date is before the Student-Section-Entry-Date, report the discrepancy as an error. [Section Exit Date] Before [Section Entry Date]
[Rule 60033] If a high school student, taking a course with a low grade/high grade between 9-12, is submitted with an Exit Type and Exit Date for courses as Complete Full Credit (CF) or Complete Partial credit (CP) and credits earned is not reported, report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 60038] If the Educator ID is not submitted for the staff, instructing the CTE course section, report the discrepancy as a warning.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 60000] If the reported value for School Year is not valid, report the discrepancy as an error. Invalid Value [School Year] (Course Section)
[Rule 60004] If the Course End Date is reported before the Course Begin Date, report the discrepancy as an error. [Course End Date] Before [Course Begin Date]
[Rule 60005] If the Course End Date is not in the current school year, report the discrepancy as an error. [Course Begin Date] not in Reported [School Year]
[Rule 60006] If the Course End Date is not in the current school year, report the discrepancy as an error. [Course End Date] not in [Reported School Year]
[Rule 60007] If the Course Section was reported with no students enrolled, report the discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 60009] If a course is not a high school course with low grade of 9 or above, report the discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 60010] If the value for a high school course is not 'Y' or 'N', report the discrepancy as an error
[Rule 60011] If the section is reported with more than 50 students, report the discrepancy as a warning. This section has more than 50 students enrolled.
[Rule 60012] If the teacher/provider teacher's Begin Date is before the Course Begin Date, report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [Begin Date] is before the course starts
[Rule 60013] If the teacher/provider teacher's Begin Date is after the Course End Date, report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [Begin Date] is after the course has ended
[Rule 60014] If the teacher/provider teachers End Date is before the course start date, report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [End Date] is before the course has started
[Rule 60015] If the teacher end date is after the course end date, then report the discrepancy as an error. The Teacher [End Date] is after the course has ended
[Rule 60026] If a student is submitted with a Course-Exit-Date and no Exit Type, report the discrepancy as an error. Exit Type is required when Course-Exit-Date is provided.
[Rule 60027] If a student is submitted in a course as Dual Credit and the course is not identified as Dual Credit, report the discrepancy as an error. Student is shown as {1} which does not align with the [Dual Credit] availability
[Rule 60029] If the Student-Course-Entry-Date is before the Course-Begin-Date, report the discrepancy as an error. Student [Course Entry Date] Before [Course Begin Date]
[Rule 60030] If the Student-Course-Exit-Date is after the Course- End-Date, report the discrepancy as an error. Student [Course Exit Date] After [Course End Date]
[Rule 60031] If the student is enrolled simultaneously in two Sections of the same Course, report the discrepancy as a warning. Student is simultaneously enrolled in two sections of the same course.
[Rule 60032] If the Student-Section-Exit-Date is before the Student-Section-Entry-Date, report the discrepancy as an error. [Section Exit Date] Before [Section Entry Date]
[Rule 60033] If a high school student, taking a course with a low grade/high grade between 9-12, is submitted with an Exit Type and Exit Date for courses as Complete Full Credit (CF) or Complete Partial credit (CP) and credits earned is not reported, report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 60038] If the Educator ID is not submitted for the staff, instructing the CTE course section, report the discrepancy as a warning.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 40000] The SPED matrix defines the validation rules for concurrent SPED needs. For a student submitted with program participation, if a combination of Need codes submitted which do not comply with the *Concurrent Need Eligibility matrix, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40003] If a student is submitted as attending SPED program participation at the entity level, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40040] If concurrent SPED program participations for a single student are reported with different DORs, fail integrity for all DORS.
[Rule 40066] If the submitted Special Education Setting does not match the program name, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40067] If a SPED program is submitted for a student without Main SPED School indicator, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40069] Student SPED participation must be within a membership at a school. If each day of SPED program participation does not have an enrollment at a given school in a given Fiscal Year, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40086] SPED14 (No longer eligible for preschool special education and not attending any education programs) is exclusively an exit code that pertains to Preschool students only and therefore may only be used when the corresponding enrollment grade is PS, and enrollment ends on the same date.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 21005] If the withdrawal date is not between July 1 and the first instructional day of track 1 at the DOA and withdrawal type is any summer withdrawal code other than S7 report discrepancy as error.
[Rule 10000] The DOA Types must be: District, Voc/Tech, Juvenile, Public SPED institution, Private/SPED, Head Start, COOP/IGA/Other, Charter.
[Rule 10001] If DOA is PRIVATE/SPED and the DOR is not DISTRICT or CHARTER, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10002] If DOA is JUVENILE and the DOR is not the same as the DOA, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10003] If DOA is a Public SPED Institution and the DOR is not the same, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10004] If DOR is a Public SPED Institution and the DOA is not the same, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10005] If DOA is a DOA EXCEPTION its DOR must be DISTRICT or CHARTER. Note that DOA EXCEPTIONs change from one fiscal year to the next, and in some fiscal years there might not be any at all (18.8).
[Rule 10006] If CTDS County Code = 20 (out of state) then only one of DOR or DOA may be out of state.
[Rule 10007] If DOA is out of state and DOR is not District or Charter, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10015] If the DOA for CEC (of any types) is not: DISTRICT, JTED, PRIVATE/SPED, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10016] If the DOA is OUT OF STATE and CEC is not CEC-A, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10018] For CEC (of any type): IF the DOA is not the same as the DOR, then DOR must be a District or JTED and the DOA must be District, JTED, Private, Other if not, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10019] If DOA is PRIVATE/SPED and CEC = B, and DOR is not District, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10021] If Special Enrollment code = Open Enrollment and DOA and DOR within the state are not the same, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10041] If DOR CTDS = IC Utah Compact Type 23 and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 012327 corresponds with 010227 (Red Mesa Unified) then report the discrepancy as an er ror. (A.R.S. § 15-823 (F))
[Rule 10042] If DOR CTDS = IC Utah Compact Type 23 and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 092327 corresponds with 090227 (Kayenta Unified), then report the discrepancy as an er ror. (A.R.S. § 15-823 (F))
[Rule 10043] If DOR CTDS = State Institution (Type 76) and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 027613 corresponds with 020213 (Willcox Unified), 057607 (Ft. Thomas/Ft. Grant) corresponds with 050207/050199001 (Dan Hinton Accommodation), 117601 corresponds with 110201 (Florence Unified), 117621 corresponds with 110221 (Coolidge Unified), then report the discrepancy as an error. (A.R.S. § 15-976)
[Rule 10044] If DOR CTDS = State Institution (Type 76) and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 057601 corresponds with 050201 (Safford Unified) then report the discrepancy as an err or. (A.R.S. § 15-976)
[Rule 10045] If DOR CTDS = State Institution (Type 76) and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 057605 corresponds with 050305 (Solomon Elementary) then report the discrepancy as a n error. (A.R.S. § 15- 976)
[Rule 10047] If DOR is out of state and the DOA is not a District or Charter, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10049] If DOR is ACCOMMODATION and DOA is ACCOMMODATION, DOA must have the permission allowing it to be listed as a district of residence. Exceptions: DOA is a DOA EXCEPTION. (18.12)
[Rule 10070] If the school of attendance is an AOI then DOA must equal DOR. Exception1: If a student in grades 9-12 has a DOR of Elementary not within a HS, then DOA may be different from DOR. Exception 2: If a student has a DOR with a role attribute of transporting district, then DOA must be different from DOR.

The "continuation of services" provision found in Section 1304(e) of the statute provides that (1) a child who ceases to be a migratory child during a school term shall be eligible for services until the end of such term; (2) a child who is no longer a migratory child may continue to receive services for one additional school year, but only if comparable services are not available through other programs; and (3) secondary school students who were eligible for services in secondary school may continue to be served through credit accrual programs until graduation. Only students who received services at any time during their 36 month eligibility period may continue to receive services (not necessarily the same service).

The eligibility expiration date is used to determine end of eligibility and to account for a child's eligibility expiring earlier than 36 months from the child's QAD. A child's eligibility would end earlier than 36 months from the child's QAD, if the child is no longer entitled to a free public education (e.g., graduated with a high school diploma, obtained a high school equivalency diploma (HSED), or for other reasons as determined by states' requirements), or if the child passes away.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 10008] If the grade submitted within the enrollment is not an approved grade for the school, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10020] If the grade submitted for an enrollment by an AOI is not KG or 1 through 12 then report discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10021] If Special Enrollment code = Open Enrollment and DOA and DOR within the state are not the same, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10057] If an enrollment is submitted with overlapping dates, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10058] If an enrollment has an Exit Status and does not have an Exit Date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10059] If an enrollment has an Exit date and does not have an Exit Status, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10084] If the First or Last day of enrollment is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10087] If the First or Last day of Special Enrollment code is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10099] If an enrollment is submitted without the required elements of Student Membership FTE, Tuition Payer Code, and DOR, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10101] If the Special Enrollment dates overlap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10102] If Special Enrollment dates reported are outside of the enrollment dates, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10108] If the Special Enrollment end date is before the Special Enrollment entry date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10111] If the submitted start date of Special Enrollment Code is < the school membership date OR if the date is > the withdrawal date (if one exists), then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10112] If a Public Special Education Institution submits an enrollment transaction with a Tuition Payer Code = 1, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10115] If an "Ancillary" enrollment is submitted without a "Main" membership for that student, or more than one enrollment is submitted with "Main" membership during the same enrollment date range of the “Ancillary”, then report discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 10119] If the withdrawal code is WP and the subsequent enrollment's RP start date is not the next instructional day of the track of the subsequent enrollment, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10120] If the withdrawal code is WD and the subsequent enrollment's RD start date is not the next instructional day of the track of the subsequent enrollment, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10121] If MembershipType for a given enrollment is P, the Entry Type should be NULL. If MembershipType is not P the Entry Type should not be NULL.
[Rule 10122] If the Student turns 22 during the current enrollment and is not receiving SPED services on his 22nd birthday, report as an error.
[Rule 10131] If any day a PS enrollment without a SPED Program is not reported with Tuition Payer Code 2 OR if any day a PS enrollment with a SPED Program is not reported with Tuition Payer Code 1 or 7, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10134] If student reported with ASDB enrollments does not have a SPED program, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10136] If a school submits more than one student enrollment record within the same start and end dates of an existing enrollment record at the same school, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10137] ASDB regional sites cannot be used for enrollment reporting in AzEDS and are for voucher use only. Please report the ASDB Voucher student at the site the student is physically attending.
[Rule 10138] Private Day School enrollment must be reported with SPED Least Restrictive Environment for all days of reported enrollment.
[Rule 10200] Students who have already graduated or received a high school diploma are not eligible to enroll in a public school. If an enrollment is submitted for a student who has previously graduated report the discrepancy as error. (Excludes Grade 12 Tuition Payer Code 9, CTED)
[Rule 20004] If the first enrollment of the year in a single track is not submitted with an "E" code for that student/school/grade, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 20017] If withdrawal activity is WP and no subsequent enrollment with a higher grade exists then, report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 20018] If withdrawal activity is WD and no subsequent enrollment with a lower grade exists then, report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 20020] If the withdrawal code is WK and there is not a subsequent enrollment date and code of EK in the same year, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 20031] If an enrollment is submitted with a summer withdrawal code S7 and entry and exit dates are not between July 1st and August 31st of the Fiscal Year then, report discrepancy as an error.
elements.edfi_standard_definition: The month, day, and year on which an individual enters and begins to receive instructional services in a school for each school year. The EntryDate value should be the date the student enrolled, or when the student's enrollment materially changed, such as with a grade promotion.  Note: Date interpretation may vary. Ed-Fi recommends inclusive dates, but states may define dates as inclusive or exclusive. For calculations, align with local guidelines.

elements.definition_text: The grade level or primary instructional level at which a student enters and receives services in a school or an educational institution during a given academic session.
elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 21000] If a student's grade and Year End Status code combination are not an approved combination, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 21001] All student memberships must have a year-end status code. If a student's grade is PS-12 including UE and the Year End Status code is not submitted by May 1st of the current fiscal year, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 21004] All student memberships must have a year-end status code. If a student's grade is PS-12 including UE and the Year End Status code is not submitted by April 1st of the current fiscal year, then report the discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 10008] If the grade submitted within the enrollment is not an approved grade for the school, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10020] If the grade submitted for an enrollment by an AOI is not KG or 1 through 12 then report discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10023] If grade = UE student is not at least 5 years old on September 1, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10026] If grade = 1st, and student is not 6 years old before January 1, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10061] If a student does not have Group B SPED participation and is of KG age when Ungraded Elementary (UE) is submitted, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10062] If the exit status is a mid-year demotion and the next grade level is not less than the grade level of the row being examined, report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10064] If a grade and the grade immediately after it are more than 1 grade apart, report the discrepancy as information.
[Rule 10065] If grade = KG, and student is not 5 years old before January 1, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10066] If grade = PS, the first day of membership cannot occur before the 90th day prior to the student’s 3rd birthday, if it does then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10067] If a student's grade is UE for ANY period in a membership and the student does NOT have an active Group B SPED Service (Group B disabilities: HI, VI, A, MD, SID, MDSSI, OI, ED-P, MOID) for every day he has a membership grade as UE. A child receiving regular instruction in one school (or district) and receiving SPED services in another school (or district) is still eligible for this benefit.
[Rule 10070] If the school of attendance is an AOI then DOA must equal DOR. Exception1: If a student in grades 9-12 has a DOR of Elementary not within a HS, then DOA may be different from DOR. Exception 2: If a student has a DOR with a role attribute of transporting district, then DOA must be different from DOR.
[Rule 10071] If a student is submitted with attendance minutes and the student does not have a homebound need, does not have a grade of PS, or does not attend an AOI school or a school with an alternative program/calendar designation, then report the discrepancy with a warning.
[Rule 10089] If grade is greater than KG and Student Membership FTE < 1.0 and school is not a JTED site then, report the possible discrepancy as: Info rmational message.
[Rule 10130] If a grade-level or school for a membership does not align with the calendar type, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10135] If the student from grade PS- 8 is submitted with grad code, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10148] This error flags students at a Secondary Transition Site that do not have a Least Restrictive Environment indicating SPED services. Secondary Transition Students must also be grade 11 or higher.
[Rule 10200] Students who have already graduated or received a high school diploma are not eligible to enroll in a public school. If an enrollment is submitted for a student who has previously graduated report the discrepancy as error. (Excludes Grade 12 Tuition Payer Code 9, CTED)
[Rule 20004] If the first enrollment of the year in a single track is not submitted with an "E" code for that student/school/grade, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 20005] If multiple "E" codes are submitted for a student/school/grade in a single year, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 20009] If a student is submitted with a withdrawal code of W7 and the grade is less than 9, including UE, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 20015] If Grade level code = PS, KG, 1st through 8th Grade and normal Graduation Year is not blank. Then report the discrepancy as warning.
[Rule 20017] If withdrawal activity is WP and no subsequent enrollment with a higher grade exists then, report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 20018] If withdrawal activity is WD and no subsequent enrollment with a lower grade exists then, report the discrepancy as an error.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 21005] If the withdrawal date is not between July 1 and the first instructional day of track 1 at the DOA and withdrawal type is any summer withdrawal code other than S7 report discrepancy as error.
[Rule 10000] The DOA Types must be: District, Voc/Tech, Juvenile, Public SPED institution, Private/SPED, Head Start, COOP/IGA/Other, Charter.
[Rule 10001] If DOA is PRIVATE/SPED and the DOR is not DISTRICT or CHARTER, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10002] If DOA is JUVENILE and the DOR is not the same as the DOA, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10003] If DOA is a Public SPED Institution and the DOR is not the same, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10004] If DOR is a Public SPED Institution and the DOA is not the same, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10005] If DOA is a DOA EXCEPTION its DOR must be DISTRICT or CHARTER. Note that DOA EXCEPTIONs change from one fiscal year to the next, and in some fiscal years there might not be any at all (18.8).
[Rule 10006] If CTDS County Code = 20 (out of state) then only one of DOR or DOA may be out of state.
[Rule 10007] If DOA is out of state and DOR is not District or Charter, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10015] If the DOA for CEC (of any types) is not: DISTRICT, JTED, PRIVATE/SPED, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10016] If the DOA is OUT OF STATE and CEC is not CEC-A, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10018] For CEC (of any type): IF the DOA is not the same as the DOR, then DOR must be a District or JTED and the DOA must be District, JTED, Private, Other if not, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10019] If DOA is PRIVATE/SPED and CEC = B, and DOR is not District, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10021] If Special Enrollment code = Open Enrollment and DOA and DOR within the state are not the same, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10041] If DOR CTDS = IC Utah Compact Type 23 and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 012327 corresponds with 010227 (Red Mesa Unified) then report the discrepancy as an er ror. (A.R.S. § 15-823 (F))
[Rule 10042] If DOR CTDS = IC Utah Compact Type 23 and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 092327 corresponds with 090227 (Kayenta Unified), then report the discrepancy as an er ror. (A.R.S. § 15-823 (F))
[Rule 10043] If DOR CTDS = State Institution (Type 76) and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 027613 corresponds with 020213 (Willcox Unified), 057607 (Ft. Thomas/Ft. Grant) corresponds with 050207/050199001 (Dan Hinton Accommodation), 117601 corresponds with 110201 (Florence Unified), 117621 corresponds with 110221 (Coolidge Unified), then report the discrepancy as an error. (A.R.S. § 15-976)
[Rule 10044] If DOR CTDS = State Institution (Type 76) and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 057601 corresponds with 050201 (Safford Unified) then report the discrepancy as an err or. (A.R.S. § 15-976)
[Rule 10045] If DOR CTDS = State Institution (Type 76) and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 057605 corresponds with 050305 (Solomon Elementary) then report the discrepancy as a n error. (A.R.S. § 15- 976)
[Rule 10047] If DOR is out of state and the DOA is not a District or Charter, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10049] If DOR is ACCOMMODATION and DOA is ACCOMMODATION, DOA must have the permission allowing it to be listed as a district of residence. Exceptions: DOA is a DOA EXCEPTION. (18.12)
[Rule 10070] If the school of attendance is an AOI then DOA must equal DOR. Exception1: If a student in grades 9-12 has a DOR of Elementary not within a HS, then DOA may be different from DOR. Exception 2: If a student has a DOR with a role attribute of transporting district, then DOA must be different from DOR.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 10084] If the First or Last day of enrollment is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10085] If the First or Last day of FTE is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this date, then report the discr epancy as an error.
[Rule 10086] If the First or Last day of Student Tuition Payer Code is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10087] If the First or Last day of Special Enrollment code is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10088] If the First or Last day of DOR Transfer is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10091] The date of absence or attendance must be on a valid in-session day for the fiscal year within the membership start and end date, else report discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 20001] If a student withdrawal is submitted on the last scheduled school day in session, report the discrepancy as an error, UNLESS the withdrawal is a W8 (deceased).

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 40000] The SPED matrix defines the validation rules for concurrent SPED needs. For a student submitted with program participation, if a combination of Need codes submitted which do not comply with the *Concurrent Need Eligibility matrix, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40003] If a student is submitted as attending SPED program participation at the entity level, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40040] If concurrent SPED program participations for a single student are reported with different DORs, fail integrity for all DORS.
[Rule 40066] If the submitted Special Education Setting does not match the program name, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40067] If a SPED program is submitted for a student without Main SPED School indicator, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40069] Student SPED participation must be within a membership at a school. If each day of SPED program participation does not have an enrollment at a given school in a given Fiscal Year, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 40086] SPED14 (No longer eligible for preschool special education and not attending any education programs) is exclusively an exit code that pertains to Preschool students only and therefore may only be used when the corresponding enrollment grade is PS, and enrollment ends on the same date.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 80001] If the program code for the Dropout Recovery Program is not valid, report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 80007] Verify Exit Reason Code/Exit Date. An Exit Reason Code must exist when a student exits from the program. If Program Exit Date is submitted (not blank) and Program Exit Reason Code is not submitted (blank), then report the discrepancy.
[Rule 80008] A Program Exit Date must exist when a student exits from the program. If Program Exit Reason Code is submitted (not blank) and Program Exit Date is not submitted (blank), then report the discrepancy.
[Rule 80009] If Approved Written Learning Plan Date and Program Entry Date are submitted, then The Approved Written Learning Plan Date must be <= Program Entry Date. If Approved Written Learning Plan Date > Program Entry Date, then report the discrepancy as error.
[Rule 80018] Monthly progress can be submitted for month codes that correspond to the Program Entry date or later. If monthly progress is submitted during a month before the Program Entry date report the discrepancy as error
[Rule 80020] To be eligible for the program, a student must not have received instruction for 10 calendar days (30 prior to FY2024) before enrolling in a DRP.
[Rule 80033] DRP If a revised learning plan date is submitted following the program end date report the discrepancy as error.
[Rule 80036] To be eligible for the program, a student must not have received instruction for 30 days prior to enrolling in a DRP. If a DRP enrollment exists within 30 calendar days prior to the current DRP enrollment, then fail Integrity. The exception to this rule is when a prior DRP enrollment is within 30 calendar days, from the prior school year, and the prior year enrollment is ended with a Year-End Status code and not a withdrawal code.

[Rule 80007] Verify Exit Reason Code/Exit Date. An Exit Reason Code must exist when a student exits from the program. If Program Exit Date is submitted (not blank) and Program Exit Reason Code is not submitted (blank), then report the discrepancy.

[Rule 80018] Monthly progress can be submitted for month codes that correspond to the Program Entry date or later. If monthly progress is submitted during a month before the Program Entry date report the discrepancy as error

[Rule 80036] To be eligible for the program, a student must not have received instruction for 30 days prior to enrolling in a DRP. If a DRP enrollment exists within 30 calendar days prior to the current DRP enrollment, then fail Integrity. The exception to this rule is when a prior DRP enrollment is within 30 calendar days, from the prior school year, and the prior year enrollment is ended with a Year-End Status code and not a withdrawal code.

elements.definition_text: Membership Type identifies whether a school has primary responsibility for managing a specific student's curriculum or not.
elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 21001] All student memberships must have a year-end status code. If a student's grade is PS-12 including UE and the Year End Status code is not submitted by May 1st of the current fiscal year, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 21004] All student memberships must have a year-end status code. If a student's grade is PS-12 including UE and the Year End Status code is not submitted by April 1st of the current fiscal year, then report the discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 10034] If the system receives more than one main school membership for a student during a single membership interval, a warning will be sent to the submitting district of the discrepancy.
[Rule 10037] If DOR end date is not <= Membership end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10055] If track number is Null and membership type is not AOI (T) or DRP (D), the report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10066] If grade = PS, the first day of membership cannot occur before the 90th day prior to the student’s 3rd birthday, if it does then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10067] If a student's grade is UE for ANY period in a membership and the student does NOT have an active Group B SPED Service (Group B disabilities: HI, VI, A, MD, SID, MDSSI, OI, ED-P, MOID) for every day he has a membership grade as UE. A child receiving regular instruction in one school (or district) and receiving SPED services in another school (or district) is still eligible for this benefit.
[Rule 10081] If membership received after previous membership in the same school for this fiscal year and no withdrawal on file for the previous membership, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10082] If the Absence amount for any Day of Membership or the Withdrawal Date is greater than the FTE value for that day, then report the discrepancy as a Warning.
[Rule 10083] If the submitted start date (old FTE start date, New FTE start date) is < the school membership date OR if the date is > the withdrawal date (if one exists), then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10084] If the First or Last day of enrollment is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10085] If the First or Last day of FTE is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this date, then report the discr epancy as an error.
[Rule 10086] If the First or Last day of Student Tuition Payer Code is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10087] If the First or Last day of Special Enrollment code is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10088] If the First or Last day of DOR Transfer is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10089] If grade is greater than KG and Student Membership FTE < 1.0 and school is not a JTED site then, report the possible discrepancy as: Info rmational message.
[Rule 10091] The date of absence or attendance must be on a valid in-session day for the fiscal year within the membership start and end date, else report discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10097] If track number is submitted and membership type is AOI (T) or DRP (D), then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10098] If track number is not submitted for membership type Main or Ancillary, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10099] If an enrollment is submitted without the required elements of Student Membership FTE, Tuition Payer Code, and DOR, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10103] If Membership FTE dates overlap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10104] If Membership FTE dates reported have a gap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10105] If the Membership end date is before the Membership entry date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10110] If the submitted start date of Tuition Payer Code is < the school membership date OR if the date is > the withdrawal date (if one exists), then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10111] If the submitted start date of Special Enrollment Code is < the school membership date OR if the date is > the withdrawal date (if one exists), then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10113] If attendance or absence is submitted for a student with MembershipType = P or D, then send a warning message.
[Rule 10115] If an "Ancillary" enrollment is submitted without a "Main" membership for that student, or more than one enrollment is submitted with "Main" membership during the same enrollment date range of the “Ancillary”, then report discrepancy as a warning.
[Rule 10121] If MembershipType for a given enrollment is P, the Entry Type should be NULL. If MembershipType is not P the Entry Type should not be NULL.
[Rule 10123] If an invalid value is submitted for Responsibility Descriptor ID (in student membership DOR), then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10125] DOR for membership type C cannot be a JTED
[Rule 10126] If membership type C is submitted for a school which is not in the list of school provided by SF, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10130] If a grade-level or school for a membership does not align with the calendar type, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10139] If a student’s membership begins on the first day of the instructional calendar and the student is not in attendance within the first 10 days, then report the discrepancy as an error. (Excludes Pre-school Tuition Payer Code 2)
[Rule 10140] If a student begins a membership on a day that is not the first instructional day of the calendar, and the student has an absence amount equal to the FTE of the first membership day or no positive attendance, then report the discrepancy as an error. (Excludes Pre-school Tuition Payer Code 2)
[Rule 10141] This warning flags students for which Average Daily Membership (ADM) will not be generated due to missing data. This data was not required prior to FY 2023 but is now necessary for new CTED ADM calculations.
[Rule 10142] This warning identifies students for which Average Daily Membership (ADM) may not be generated as expected due to a data entry error. Students attending CTED community college school sites generate ADM based on total community college enrolled credits, rather than total planned instructional hours. This data was not required prior to FY 2023 but is now necessary for new CTED ADM calculations.
[Rule 10143] This error flags students for which Average Daily Membership (ADM) will not be generated due to missing data. This data was not required prior to FY 2023 but is now necessary for new CTED ADM calculations.
[Rule 10144] This error flags students for which Average Daily Membership (ADM) may not be generated as intended due to a data entry error. Students enrolled in CTED satellite, centralized, and leased centralized school sites generate ADM based on total planned instructional hours, rather than total community college enrolled credits. This data was not required prior to FY 2023 but is now necessary for new CTED ADM calculations.
[Rule 10147] If the DOR listed on a membership is no longer active, report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10201] Students with GCD or DRP memberships should have a corresponding program association (DRP = Program Type 61 and GCD = Program Type 60). If a Membership Type D or Membership Type G is submitted without a corresponding program association report discrepancy as error.
[Rule 20011] If the readmission entry date is prior to the Membership date, then report the discrepancy as an error
[Rule 20012] If readmission entry date is earlier than the withdrawal date of Membership, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 20038] If membership has a withdrawal code of WK and the student didn't switch calendars, move from UE to KG, or move from KG to UE, then report the discrepancy as an error.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 10001] If DOA is PRIVATE/SPED and the DOR is not DISTRICT or CHARTER, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10002] If DOA is JUVENILE and the DOR is not the same as the DOA, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10003] If DOA is a Public SPED Institution and the DOR is not the same, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10004] If DOR is a Public SPED Institution and the DOA is not the same, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10005] If DOA is a DOA EXCEPTION its DOR must be DISTRICT or CHARTER. Note that DOA EXCEPTIONs change from one fiscal year to the next, and in some fiscal years there might not be any at all (18.8).
[Rule 10006] If CTDS County Code = 20 (out of state) then only one of DOR or DOA may be out of state.
[Rule 10007] If DOA is out of state and DOR is not District or Charter, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10018] For CEC (of any type): IF the DOA is not the same as the DOR, then DOR must be a District or JTED and the DOA must be District, JTED, Private, Other if not, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10019] If DOA is PRIVATE/SPED and CEC = B, and DOR is not District, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10021] If Special Enrollment code = Open Enrollment and DOA and DOR within the state are not the same, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10037] If DOR end date is not <= Membership end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10038] If DOR dates overlap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10039] If DOR dates have a gap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10040] If the DOR is not a Valid DOR type, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10041] If DOR CTDS = IC Utah Compact Type 23 and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 012327 corresponds with 010227 (Red Mesa Unified) then report the discrepancy as an er ror. (A.R.S. § 15-823 (F))
[Rule 10042] If DOR CTDS = IC Utah Compact Type 23 and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 092327 corresponds with 090227 (Kayenta Unified), then report the discrepancy as an er ror. (A.R.S. § 15-823 (F))
[Rule 10043] If DOR CTDS = State Institution (Type 76) and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 027613 corresponds with 020213 (Willcox Unified), 057607 (Ft. Thomas/Ft. Grant) corresponds with 050207/050199001 (Dan Hinton Accommodation), 117601 corresponds with 110201 (Florence Unified), 117621 corresponds with 110221 (Coolidge Unified), then report the discrepancy as an error. (A.R.S. § 15-976)
[Rule 10044] If DOR CTDS = State Institution (Type 76) and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 057601 corresponds with 050201 (Safford Unified) then report the discrepancy as an err or. (A.R.S. § 15-976)
[Rule 10045] If DOR CTDS = State Institution (Type 76) and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 057605 corresponds with 050305 (Solomon Elementary) then report the discrepancy as a n error. (A.R.S. § 15- 976)
[Rule 10047] If DOR is out of state and the DOA is not a District or Charter, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10048] If DOR is ACCOMMODATION, DOR must be allowed to be listed as a district of residence (18.12.1)
[Rule 10049] If DOR is ACCOMMODATION and DOA is ACCOMMODATION, DOA must have the permission allowing it to be listed as a district of residence. Exceptions: DOA is a DOA EXCEPTION. (18.12)
[Rule 10050] If the DOR is OUT OF STATE and CEC of any type is reported, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10051] If the DOR is UNORGANIZED (CTDS 000400 or 000500) and the reported CEC is not CEC- A, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10052] If the DOR types for CEC is not DISTRICT or JTED, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10070] If the school of attendance is an AOI then DOA must equal DOR. Exception1: If a student in grades 9-12 has a DOR of Elementary not within a HS, then DOA may be different from DOR. Exception 2: If a student has a DOR with a role attribute of transporting district, then DOA must be different from DOR.
[Rule 10088] If the First or Last day of DOR Transfer is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10099] If an enrollment is submitted without the required elements of Student Membership FTE, Tuition Payer Code, and DOR, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10123] If an invalid value is submitted for Responsibility Descriptor ID (in student membership DOR), then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10125] DOR for membership type C cannot be a JTED
[Rule 10147] If the DOR listed on a membership is no longer active, report the discrepancy as an error.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 10068] If Tuition Payer dates overlap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10069] If Tuition Payer dates reported have a gap, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10086] If the First or Last day of Student Tuition Payer Code is not a valid session date in the school's calendar for the track identified in the membership during the fiscal year indicated by this end date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10099] If an enrollment is submitted without the required elements of Student Membership FTE, Tuition Payer Code, and DOR, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10107] If the Tuition Payer end date is before the Tuition Payer entry date, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10110] If the submitted start date of Tuition Payer Code is < the school membership date OR if the date is > the withdrawal date (if one exists), then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10112] If a Public Special Education Institution submits an enrollment transaction with a Tuition Payer Code = 1, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10131] If any day a PS enrollment without a SPED Program is not reported with Tuition Payer Code 2 OR if any day a PS enrollment with a SPED Program is not reported with Tuition Payer Code 1 or 7, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10132] Any day a student is reported Tuition Payer Code 4, a SPED program may not be reported
[Rule 10133] Any day a student is reported Tuition Payer Code 7, a SPED program must be reported
[Rule 10139] If a student’s membership begins on the first day of the instructional calendar and the student is not in attendance within the first 10 days, then report the discrepancy as an error. (Excludes Pre-school Tuition Payer Code 2)
[Rule 10140] If a student begins a membership on a day that is not the first instructional day of the calendar, and the student has an absence amount equal to the FTE of the first membership day or no positive attendance, then report the discrepancy as an error. (Excludes Pre-school Tuition Payer Code 2)
[Rule 10200] Students who have already graduated or received a high school diploma are not eligible to enroll in a public school. If an enrollment is submitted for a student who has previously graduated report the discrepancy as error. (Excludes Grade 12 Tuition Payer Code 9, CTED)
[Rule 10206] If a student attending ASDB is not reported with Tuition Payer Code = 7, then report the discrepancy as error.
[Rule 10207] If a student attending a Residential Treatment Center is not reported with Tuition Payer Code = 4 or 7, then report the discrepancy as error.

elements.business_rules_text:
[Rule 21005] If the withdrawal date is not between July 1 and the first instructional day of track 1 at the DOA and withdrawal type is any summer withdrawal code other than S7 report discrepancy as error.
[Rule 10000] The DOA Types must be: District, Voc/Tech, Juvenile, Public SPED institution, Private/SPED, Head Start, COOP/IGA/Other, Charter.
[Rule 10001] If DOA is PRIVATE/SPED and the DOR is not DISTRICT or CHARTER, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10002] If DOA is JUVENILE and the DOR is not the same as the DOA, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10003] If DOA is a Public SPED Institution and the DOR is not the same, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10004] If DOR is a Public SPED Institution and the DOA is not the same, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10005] If DOA is a DOA EXCEPTION its DOR must be DISTRICT or CHARTER. Note that DOA EXCEPTIONs change from one fiscal year to the next, and in some fiscal years there might not be any at all (18.8).
[Rule 10006] If CTDS County Code = 20 (out of state) then only one of DOR or DOA may be out of state.
[Rule 10007] If DOA is out of state and DOR is not District or Charter, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10015] If the DOA for CEC (of any types) is not: DISTRICT, JTED, PRIVATE/SPED, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10016] If the DOA is OUT OF STATE and CEC is not CEC-A, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10018] For CEC (of any type): IF the DOA is not the same as the DOR, then DOR must be a District or JTED and the DOA must be District, JTED, Private, Other if not, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10019] If DOA is PRIVATE/SPED and CEC = B, and DOR is not District, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10021] If Special Enrollment code = Open Enrollment and DOA and DOR within the state are not the same, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10041] If DOR CTDS = IC Utah Compact Type 23 and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 012327 corresponds with 010227 (Red Mesa Unified) then report the discrepancy as an er ror. (A.R.S. § 15-823 (F))
[Rule 10042] If DOR CTDS = IC Utah Compact Type 23 and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 092327 corresponds with 090227 (Kayenta Unified), then report the discrepancy as an er ror. (A.R.S. § 15-823 (F))
[Rule 10043] If DOR CTDS = State Institution (Type 76) and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 027613 corresponds with 020213 (Willcox Unified), 057607 (Ft. Thomas/Ft. Grant) corresponds with 050207/050199001 (Dan Hinton Accommodation), 117601 corresponds with 110201 (Florence Unified), 117621 corresponds with 110221 (Coolidge Unified), then report the discrepancy as an error. (A.R.S. § 15-976)
[Rule 10044] If DOR CTDS = State Institution (Type 76) and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 057601 corresponds with 050201 (Safford Unified) then report the discrepancy as an err or. (A.R.S. § 15-976)
[Rule 10045] If DOR CTDS = State Institution (Type 76) and the DOA does not correspond to one of the following: 057605 corresponds with 050305 (Solomon Elementary) then report the discrepancy as a n error. (A.R.S. § 15- 976)
[Rule 10047] If DOR is out of state and the DOA is not a District or Charter, then report the discrepancy as an error.
[Rule 10049] If DOR is ACCOMMODATION and DOA is ACCOMMODATION, DOA must have the permission allowing it to be listed as a district of residence. Exceptions: DOA is a DOA EXCEPTION. (18.12)
[Rule 10070] If the school of attendance is an AOI then DOA must equal DOR. Exception1: If a student in grades 9-12 has a DOR of Elementary not within a HS, then DOA may be different from DOR. Exception 2: If a student has a DOR with a role attribute of transporting district, then DOA must be different from DOR.
